notes: Obesity: WHO GHO NCD_BMI_30C (age-standardised, BMI>=30) gives Niue 66.2% both sexes, 63.0% male, 69.2% female (2024) - real WHO modelled estimates, used in preference to CIA Factbook's '50% (2016)' which cites an older figure.

Mean BMI and smoking: WHO STEPS Survey Niue 2011 fact sheet (n=916, census-based, measured): current tobacco smoking 22.6% male / 13.0% female / 17.7% both; mean BMI 31.1 male / 32.5 female. Note: Niue STEPS 2025 (n=726) reports combined 'tobacco use and smoking' at 38% but no sex split published yet.

Weight derived from STEPS mean BMI applied to NZ-anchor heights (BMI x height^2): female 32.5x1.64^2=87kg, male 31.1x1.77^2=97kg. No Niue-specific height data exists (NCD-RisC does not cover Niue); NZ anchor heights retained.
Life expectancy: CIA Factbook (factbook.json archive) male 71.8 years (2016), female 75.7 years (2016). Total-population value not published; ~73.7 implied by near-equal sex ratio.
adolescentBirthRate: UN WPP via OWID grapher 'adolescent-birth-rate' shows 0 births per 1,000 women 15-19 for Niue in all recent years (2014-2022).
childMarriagePercent set to 0: high-income NZ-associated territory, no recorded under-18 marriages; consistent with GB anchor convention.
laborForceGap (-8.7) and contraceptiveUse (74.3) derived from NZ anchor (ladder exhausted: World Bank, WHO GHO and Factbook carry no Niue LFS-by-sex or contraceptive prevalence data).
Life expectancy: CIA Factbook (factbook.json archive, 2024 est.) total 76.1 years, male 76.9, female 75.3 - the male>female pattern is as published by the source.

Smoking: Montserrat Ministry of Health/UKHSA Morbidity and Risk Factor Prevalence Survey (Feb-Mar 2022, n=304) found 13.5% ever-regular smokers (23.6% male, 6.2% female); of the 41 ever-smokers only 16 had smoked in the last 7 days (13 male, 3 female), i.e. current smoking ~10% male / ~2% female / ~5% overall. Those current values are used.

Obesity: no measured obesity data exists for Montserrat (World Obesity Observatory has no adult data; WHO GHO NCD_BMI_30C EMPTY; Factbook has no field). Derived: combined 35% from nearest comparable Caribbean territory (USVI 35%, CDC via batch_29); sexed split F38/M31 applies GB anchor's female-minus-male differential (+3.4pp) to that total. Flagged as estimate.
Heights/weights/BMI derived from GB anchor values unchanged - no territory-specific anthropometric source exists (NCD-RisC does not cover Montserrat).
adolescentBirthRate: UN WPP via OWID grapher 'adolescent-birth-rate' shows 0 births per 1,000 women 15-19 for Montserrat in recent years (2016-2020).
childMarriagePercent set to 0: UK overseas territory with no recorded under-18 marriages; consistent with GB anchor convention.
laborForceGap (-8.3) and contraceptiveUse (76.1) derived from GB anchor (ladder exhausted: World Bank and WHO GHO carry no Montserrat LFS-by-sex or contraceptive prevalence data).

All health fields derived from AU anchor - ladder exhausted for Norfolk Island: World Bank has no NFK data; WHO GHO NCD_BMI_30C and tobacco indicators EMPTY for NFK; CIA Factbook entry (factbook.json) carries no People-and-Society health fields at all; UN WPP via OWID has no Norfolk Island rows; World Obesity Observatory does not list the territory.

Norfolk Island is a full Australian territory (services delivered via NSW/QLD/ACT since 2016), population ~1,800-2,200 with predominantly Australian/English ancestry, so anchor values without adjustment are the most defensible derivation.
childMarriagePercent set to 0: Australian territory, no recorded under-18 marriages; consistent with GB anchor convention for developed economies.
